medicines.note: Review QT, constipation and hepatic dosing; reconcile any steroid already prescribed

medicines.dose: 10 mg orally up to three times daily as needed
medicines.timing: Subsequent days: duration to be confirmed

additional_support: Dexamethasone 8 mg orally twice daily for three days starting the day before docetaxel, unless contraindicated; NCCP requires at least three pre-treatment doses. Missed doses require consultant review; 20 mg IV immediately before infusion is a discretionary alternative.
Avoid duplicate corticosteroid prescriptions. G-CSF may be used after individual risk assessment. Monitor fluid retention and neuropathy.
Low emetic risk: prevention and rescue medicines remain separate from reaction premedication. Confirm individual suitability, interactions and duration; this reference is not a prescription.

medicines.name: Metoclopramide
medicines.dose: 10 mg orally up to three times daily as needed

additional_support: NCCP first-dose suggested premedication: dexamethasone 8 mg IV, chlorphenamine 10 mg IV and famotidine 20 mg IV 30 minutes before infusion.

From Day 8, NCCP permits omission of routine dexamethasone; previous reaction or higher risk requires consultant-directed adjustment. Famotidine omission is also a consultant/local-policy decision with close observation.
The actual conventional product SmPC uses a different generic premedication schedule. Reconcile the exact product and local protocol; no automatic patient-led omission or switch to nab-paclitaxel.
Consider analgesia for muscle/joint aches; review neuropathy before every dose and growth-factor support when indicated.

lung.label: Vinorelbine IV · non-small-cell lung cancer · support plan
additional_support: Individual antiemetic plan differs by route; list routine and rescue medicines separately.
Discuss constipation prevention, hydration/diet where appropriate and prescribed laxatives; regular opioid use increases the need for a bowel plan.

No routine steroid premedication, G-CSF, antibacterial, antiviral or PJP prophylaxis is mandated by these NCCP monotherapy documents. Consider additional prevention based on individual risk/local policy; do not create a generic automatic prescription.
Gastric protection is a consideration for high gastrointestinal-bleed risk, not a universal drug.

Confirm strong CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers, P-gp modulators, phenytoin, itraconazole, warfarin and live vaccines. Yellow fever vaccine is contraindicated. Avoid grapefruit per NCCP; do not self-start supplements.
No routine prophylaxis required by NCCP minimal-risk pathway.
Prescriber selects an as-needed medicine according to symptoms, constipation, QT/interactions and local policy. Reassess before future doses if nausea/vomiting occurs.

lung.label: Vinorelbine capsules · non-small-cell lung cancer · support plan

medicines.name: One 5-HT3 antagonist · choose a single option
medicines.dose: Ondansetron 8–16 mg total daily OR granisetron 1–2 mg total daily
medicines.timing: Around the weekly dose; the prescriber must state the number of subsequent days
medicines.note: NCCP Table 5 oral pathway. Do not combine both agents or assume indefinite daily treatment. Review constipation, QT risk and interacting medicines.

additional_support: Individual antiemetic plan differs by route; list routine and rescue medicines separately.
Discuss constipation prevention, hydration/diet where appropriate and prescribed laxatives; regular opioid use increases the need for a bowel plan.

No routine steroid premedication, G-CSF, antibacterial, antiviral or PJP prophylaxis is mandated by these NCCP monotherapy documents. Consider additional prevention based on individual risk/local policy; do not create a generic automatic prescription.
Gastric protection is a consideration for high gastrointestinal-bleed risk, not a universal drug.

Confirm strong CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers, P-gp modulators, phenytoin, itraconazole, warfarin and live vaccines. Yellow fever vaccine is contraindicated. Avoid grapefruit per NCCP; do not self-start supplements.

Table 5 says continue daily; for once-weekly vinorelbine the prescriber must state the number of days. Do not automatically turn this into indefinite daily treatment or import an IV moderate steroid/NK1 schedule.
A separate locally approved as-needed plan; check constipation and QT/interactions. Avoid duplicate 5-HT3 agents. Ondansetron can worsen constipation.

lung.label: Bevacizumab lung component · support plan
additional_support: Bevacizumab itself usually needs no routine anti-sickness premedication. Platinum chemotherapy needs its own anti-sickness and other support plan. Erlotinib needs its own tablet, interaction, skin and diarrhoea plan. Keep the complete plan and emergency numbers.
No routine bevacizumab antiemetic prophylaxis; assess partner chemotherapy emetic risk separately.
Anti-diarrhoeal medicines only if required under local policy.
Maintain BP/urine, procedure/wound and urgent-contact plans.
At the platinum-to-bevacizumab continuation change, review and stop or adapt partner-specific support only on the prescriber’s instruction. Erlotinib support continues according to its own plan.
